headline: MTN Uganda Nine-Month Profit Rises 21% on Mobile Money Growth
summary: MTN Uganda reported a 21% increase in profit to Sh18 billion for the first nine months, supported by an 8.5% rise in sales driven by mobile money and data revenue.
why: Telecommunications operators in emerging markets rely heavily on mobile financial services and data services to drive top-line revenue growth.

impacts.name: MTN Uganda
impacts.why: MTN Uganda posted a 21% profit increase for the nine-month period.
